applies_why: The judge text resolves a link collision by requiring explicit textual resolution of paternity, which is the verse-level stating-verse inquiry K-C governs and retires.
quote: D6 vs C4 (Romans 1:3): UNDERDETERMINED -- answered in [CR2] section A.1-2 and [CR3] Link 6 premises 1-3, where descent according to the flesh is weighed against conception of the Holy Ghost without explicit textual resolution of paternity.
rule_words: When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.
room: The phrase 'without explicit textual resolution of paternity': one reading is that the judge requires an explicit verse to resolve the paternity collision, a retired stating-verse test; the other is that the judge merely reports an unresolved chain-by-chain weighing, which K-C allows.
why: The judge labels the collision UNDERDETERMINED because of the absence of explicit textual resolution, which uses the retired stating-verse test rather than weighing the chains by footing.
